text: {"lessons":["My account recovered after several declines, then fell again; short-term moves are unpredictable, so I should avoid reacting to one month’s performance.","Buying Stocks A, B and D used cash, so I should check that any new trades fit my overall allocation and leave enough cash for flexibility.","I should judge my progress over a longer period against my apartment goal and risk tolerance, rather than treating a few months of account values as proof that a strategy is working."]}
